scope.note: Three page sources with selected public/consumer states. Merchant branding, fonts, image geometry, existing grids/widths, category ordering and checkout composition are preserved. No claim that all shared components or the complete redesign are accepted.

appearance: Public catalog uses opaque themed surfaces and borders with smaller floating-cart shadows. The merchant accent/font/header/logo remain authoritative; accent actions choose black or white text from relative luminance, including a white merchant accent verified in the rendered unit test.

Loyalty keeps the existing max-w-md card/join layout, three-column rules and history order. QR retains its outer 224px square, now with a white 8px quiet-area padding in both themes. New errors add contextual recovery panels only when an operation fails.

Catalog search focus has one 1px blue border, outline:none and box-shadow:none in the final real mobile browser. The earlier shared-field focus rules are retained; no global removal of control focus was added.
explicitBehaviorChanges: Catalog retry increments its actual client-fetch dependency instead of calling router.refresh(), which did not refetch the client-loaded data. Real stopped-server/restarted-server UI recovery retains the search condition and an off-page cart product.

A true 404 has the existing missing-catalog message; HTTP/network failures have a generic translated error and working retry, without raw network details. Initial skeleton is an accessible loading status. Category disclosure has expanded/controls relationships, checkout errors are alerts, cart close has an explicit focus target and uses search after the cart trigger disappears.
The public catalog brand link no longer announces BAZAAR twice. The image and destination are preserved. Legacy English empty-cart copy is corrected.
Initial loyalty card/join server read errors show a retry component instead of false no-session/unavailable copy. Genuine unauthorized, missing and disabled states keep their existing policy.

Card/consent read failures visibly retain the last confirmed card and can retry. Poll responses are ordered and ignored after unmount or session rejection; an old poll cannot overwrite a newer confirmed balance. A real 401 hides the card and QR.

QR failures are visible and retryable; malformed/expired QR payloads are rejected. A still-valid previous QR is retained on transient refresh failure. Normal QR expiry hides its image. Sign-out checks HTTP/network success and reports failure without pretending the session ended.

The code-stage field receives focus after an accepted OTP request; changing email clears stale form errors. Verification, OTP policy, session issuance, authorization and all monetary/loyalty calculations are unchanged.

Two REST transport corrections are explicitly included: card GET and QR POST use AppError status/message, classify unexpected failures as 500/genericMessage instead of false 401/raw exception details, and return no-store. No Prisma schema or loyalty calculation/service change in this checkpoint.
